<span id="armour" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Armour</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="general-armour-introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>General Armour Introduction</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are three categories of armour:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Power</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: any armour with a style bonus</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Hybrid</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: anything stated as &quot;hybrid&quot;</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Tank</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: any other item (also has more armour than power / hybrid)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Armour tiers are based on the level required to equip them</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Equipping armour provides style and armour bonuses</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These bonuses are based on armour category and tier</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Generally armours in the same category and tier will have equal bonuses</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Wearing off-style armour slots (excluding cape slot) provides an accuracy penalty based on armour bonus</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• &quot;Off-style&quot; is any style that does not match your equipped main hand / 2H weapon</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hybrid gear incurs no penalty</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This penalty is near-doubled (0.8 → 1.5) when using the Necromancy combat style.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Some armour sets have </nowiki><strong><nowiki>set effects</nowiki></strong><nowiki> which may be useful</nowiki></p>

<div><u><nowiki>Index of Armour</nowiki></u>
</div>
<div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to look up further information on the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoury <nowiki>Wiki</nowiki>]<nowiki>
⬥ Armour in </nowiki><strong><nowiki>bold</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is worth being aware of, they will be elaborated on after or are recommended in the respective upgrade order
⬥ Use </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>!armour</nowiki></code><nowiki> to see DPS difference between the armour
⬥ Generally speaking, use </nowiki><strong><nowiki>power armour</nowiki></strong>
</div>

</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ When </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dbreath">[[File:Dragon Breath.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dbreath</nowiki>|<nowiki>dbreath</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is cast, the next </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="combust">[[File:Combust.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>combust</nowiki>|<nowiki>combust</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to hit within 6s has all its remaining hits applied at once for 25% (40% with </nowiki><strong><nowiki>enchantment of flame</nowiki></strong><nowiki>) more damage
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Elite Dracolich Gloves</nowiki></u> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="edracogloves">[[File:Elite Dracolich vambraces.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717613769728100.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>edracogloves</nowiki>|<nowiki>edracogloves</nowiki>]]</span>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Adds to the passive effects from the armour set

    • </nowiki><em><nowiki>Dracolich infusion</nowiki></em><nowiki> at 3 pieces, after a full </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="rapid">[[File:Rapid Fire.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>rapid</nowiki>|<nowiki>rapid</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> gain +40% critical strike chance with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for 3 seconds, +1.8 seconds for every additional piece
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Nightmare Gauntlets</nowiki></u> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="NMG">[[File:Nightmare gauntlets.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159441723392.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>NMG</nowiki>|<nowiki>NMG</nowiki>]]</span>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="snipe">[[File:Snipe.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>snipe</nowiki>|<nowiki>snipe</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> has +25% hitchance and can move while channelling
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Enchantment of dread</nowiki></strong><nowiki> makes </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="snipe">[[File:Snipe.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>snipe</nowiki>|<nowiki>snipe</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to do a 2nd weaker hit when flanking
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Gloves of Passage</nowiki></u> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="glovesofpassage">[[File:Gloves of passage.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694862037012.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>glovesofpassage</nowiki>|<nowiki>glovesofpassage</nowiki>]]</span>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ After </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="rend">[[File:Rend.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>rend</nowiki>|<nowiki>rend</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is cast the following occurs (same target):

⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Spellcaster's Gloves</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spellcaster">[[File:Spellcaster gloves.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643214402169864213.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spellcaster</nowiki>|<nowiki>spellcaster</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> - autos / basics have 5% chance to do 25% more damage, bind target, lower their combat stats by 7 levels and hit 1t after cast

⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Vampyrism Gloves</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="vampyrismgloves">[[File:Vampyrism gloves.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1487224784428335255.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>vampyrismgloves</nowiki>|<nowiki>vampyrismgloves</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> - heals the player for 2% of the damage they deal, up to a maximum of 20 life points restored per hit

</div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Capes</nowiki></u>

⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Igneous Kal-Mor</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="igneouskalmor">[[File:Igneous Kal-Mor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>igneouskalmor</nowiki>|<nowiki>igneouskalmor</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> - </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathskulls">[[File:Death Skulls.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathskulls</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathskulls</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> bounces 2 more times

<span id="weapons" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Weapons</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="general-weapons-introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>General Weapons Introduction</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The tier of a weapon is the listed equip requirement. Generally the damage and accuracy tier match that</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exceptions include: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="lanispear">[[File:Laniakea's spear.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>lanispear</nowiki>|<nowiki>lanispear</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (T90 damage, T75 accuracy), GWD2 weapons (T80 damage, T90 accuracy), and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="darkiceshard">[[File:Dark ice shard.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/915232154160594974.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>darkiceshard</nowiki>|<nowiki>darkiceshard</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="darkicesliver">[[File:Dark ice sliver.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/915232153787334677.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>darkicesliver</nowiki>|<nowiki>darkicesliver</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (T88 damage, T85 accuracy)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ For dual-wield weapons:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overall damage tier is equal to 66% of the main hand's tier and 33% of the off-hand's tier</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overall accuracy tier you have is equal to your main hand's tier fully.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ For ammo'd </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> weapons and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> weapons:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage tier is equal to the minimum between the weapon tier and the ammo / spell tier</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ E.g. a T90 weapon with a T1 ammo / spell has T1 damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Notable Weapons</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="tumekenslight">[[File:Tumeken's Light.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>tumekenslight</nowiki>|<nowiki>tumekenslight</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is BiS halberd with a strong AoE passive and spec</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="noxbow">[[File:Noxious longbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159425208342.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>noxbow</nowiki>|<nowiki>noxbow</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is a solid 2H to use until </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bolg">[[File:Bow of the Last Guardian.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bolg</nowiki>|<nowiki>bolg</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="masterworkspearofannihilation">[[File:Masterwork Spear of Annihilation.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>masterworkspearofannihilation</nowiki>|<nowiki>masterworkspearofannihilation</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> increases </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dismember">[[File:Dismember.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dismember</nowiki>|<nowiki>dismember</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="slaughter">[[File:Slaughter.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062904732418159.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>slaughter</nowiki>|<nowiki>slaughter</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="massacre">[[File:Massacre.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062911619469495.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>massacre</nowiki>|<nowiki>massacre</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> duration by 50%, rounded down</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> best 2H until </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bolg">[[File:Bow of the Last Guardian.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bolg</nowiki>|<nowiki>bolg</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. Has a strong special attack, see </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>!sgb</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for some more info</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ecb">[[File:Eldritch crossbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>|<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> has a very strong special attack, but is relatively hard to use well</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="roarofawakening">[[File:Roar of Awakening.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>roarofawakening</nowiki>|<nowiki>roarofawakening</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="odetodeceit">[[File:Ode to Deceit.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>odetodeceit</nowiki>|<nowiki>odetodeceit</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> have passive effects and a special attack on the mainhand, see </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>!sanctumdw</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for more info</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="soa">[[File:Fractured Staff of Armadyl.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>soa</nowiki>|<nowiki>soa</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> has one of the strongest special attacks, and passive effects. See </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>!fsoa</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for some more info</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bolg">[[File:Bow of the Last Guardian.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bolg</nowiki>|<nowiki>bolg</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> best 2H, has a strong spec, and is very consistent, see </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>!bolg</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for more info</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ezk">[[File:Ek-ZekKil.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ezk</nowiki>|<nowiki>ezk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> strong passive, deals high damage if spec is used on </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="flameboundrival">[[File:Flamebound Rival.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1404885709034229922.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>flameboundrival</nowiki>|<nowiki>flameboundrival</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathguard70">[[File:Death guard (tier 70).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathguard70</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathguard70</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> has a great special attack (can use t70 for </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="eofblack">https://files.catbox.moe/xs5f2x.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412915855380.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki>!)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="omniguard">[[File:Omni guard.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>omniguard</nowiki>|<nowiki>omniguard</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> best necromancy main hand</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="soulboundlantern">[[File:Soulbound lantern.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>soulboundlantern</nowiki>|<nowiki>soulboundlantern</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> best necromancy off-hand</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="lengmh">[[File:Dark Shard of Leng.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>lengmh</nowiki>|<nowiki>lengmh</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="lengoh">[[File:Dark Sliver of Leng.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308070604870.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>lengoh</nowiki>|<nowiki>lengoh</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> have passive effects and a special attack on the main hand</nowiki></p>

<div><u><nowiki>Defenders and Shields</nowiki></u>
</div>
<div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to look up further information on the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoury <nowiki>Wiki</nowiki>]<nowiki>
⬥ Use </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>!defender</nowiki></code><nowiki> for info on obtaining defenders
⬥ Defender weapon and shield tier is half its tier (e.g. T90 defender is T45)
⬥ Defenders provide 3% accuracy and 1/15 chance to reduce hit by 50-100%
⬥ T90 shields' right-click voke option drops target when using queueing
⬥ Spirit shields reduce damage by 30%, 20% of it is removed from prayer
⬥ Shieldbows count as a MH + shield of its tier (e.g. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dbow">[[File:Dark bow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>|<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is a T70 MH + shield)
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Bone shield</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="lesserboneshield">[[File:Lesser Bone Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>lesserboneshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>lesserboneshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="greaterboneshield">[[File:Greater Bone Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>greaterboneshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>greaterboneshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is unlocked via </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and allows the use of defensive shield abilities without a physical shield, costing necrotic runes.
    • With lvl120 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zemouregalsnexus">[[File:Zemouregal's nexus.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zemouregalsnexus</nowiki>|<nowiki>zemouregalsnexus</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="greaterboneshield">[[File:Greater Bone Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>greaterboneshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>greaterboneshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> you can reach up to bone shield tier 75.
</nowiki></div>
<div><div><div><u><nowiki>T90 Shields</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Merciless </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="merciless">[[File:Merciless kiteshield.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553021457645579.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>merciless</nowiki>|<nowiki>merciless</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)
⬥ Vengeful </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="vengeful">[[File:Vengeful kiteshield.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553026415313006.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>vengeful</nowiki>|<nowiki>vengeful</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)
⬥ Malevolent </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="malevkite">[[File:Malevolent kiteshield.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553024536252466.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>malevkite</nowiki>|<nowiki>malevkite</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Attack">[[File:Attack-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>|<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Spirit Shields (T75)</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Arcane </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="arcanespiritshield">[[File:Arcane spirit shield.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690976219612708954.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>arcanespiritshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>arcanespiritshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)
⬥ Elysian </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="elysianspiritshield">[[File:Elysian spirit shield.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690976217792250007.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>elysianspiritshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>elysianspiritshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)
⬥ Divine </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="divinespiritshield">[[File:Divine spirit shield.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690976217792249896.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>divinespiritshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>divinespiritshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Attack">[[File:Attack-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>|<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)
⬥ Spectral </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spectralspiritshield">[[File:Spectral spirit shield.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148977577059430461.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spectralspiritshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>spectralspiritshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Defenders</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Corrupted </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="corrupteddefender">[[File:Corrupted defender.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/923248842000957480.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>corrupteddefender</nowiki>|<nowiki>corrupteddefender</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (T70)
⬥ Ancient </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ancientrepriser">[[File:Ancient repriser.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643150658891153428.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>|<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (T80)
⬥ Kalphite </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="kalphiterebounder">[[File:Kalphite rebounder.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846849223983125.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>kalphiterebounder</nowiki>|<nowiki>kalphiterebounder</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (T90)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Shieldbows</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Darkbow </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dbow">[[File:Dark bow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>|<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (T70)
⬥ Strykebow </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="strykebow">[[File:Strykebow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643109318845267988.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>strykebow</nowiki>|<nowiki>strykebow</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (T85)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Generally When to use What</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Bone shield </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="lesserboneshield">[[File:Lesser Bone Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>lesserboneshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>lesserboneshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="greaterboneshield">[[File:Greater Bone Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>greaterboneshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>greaterboneshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> work for most scenarios where a very high shield tier is unimportant 
    • Defenders when needing to do offensive shield abilities (e.g. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="revenge">[[File:Revenge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259645878302.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>revenge</nowiki>|<nowiki>revenge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>), but are effectively superseded by </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="lesserboneshield">[[File:Lesser Bone Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>lesserboneshield</nowiki>|<nowiki>lesserboneshield</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
⬥ Spirit Shields when needing to use effect to tank large hits
⬥ Shieldbows when using a bow
⬥ T90 shields otherwise (e.g. for bigger </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="divert">[[File:Divert.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>divert</nowiki>|<nowiki>divert</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or very long </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)
</nowiki></div></div></div>

<div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ring of Death</nowiki></u> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="RoD">[[File:Ring of death.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>RoD</nowiki>|<nowiki>RoD</nowiki>]]</span>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ On target death, 50% chance to gain 1% adren per 1.5k hp of it (caps at 5%)
⬥ On player death, the player is revived at full health and a damage-over-time effect is applied for three minutes
⬥ Overchargeable at Death for 5 cut onyx and 25 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="blackstoneheart">[[File:Black stone heart.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643162243571122196.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>blackstoneheart</nowiki>|<nowiki>blackstoneheart</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (has 5x charges)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Channeler's Ring</nowiki></u> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="channellerring">[[File:Channeller's ring.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>channellerring</nowiki>|<nowiki>channellerring</nowiki>]]</span>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Each hit of a </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> channel has (4 * channel hits done)% more crit chance
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Metaphysics enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki> causes +(2.5 * channel hits done) % crit dmg
⬥ To clarify: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="channellerring">[[File:Channeller's ring.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>channellerring</nowiki>|<nowiki>channellerring</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and its enchantment </nowiki><strong><nowiki>only affect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> channels, not autos, etc.</nowiki></strong>
</div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Champion's Ring</nowiki></u> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="championring">[[File:Champion's ring.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943630520350.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>championring</nowiki>|<nowiki>championring</nowiki>]]</span>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Attack">[[File:Attack-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>|<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> attacks gain 3% (4% if </nowiki><strong><nowiki>heroism enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki>) crit chance if target bled
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Heroism enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki> also adds (1.5 * bleed count)% crit damage
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Stalker's Ring</nowiki></u> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="stalkerring">[[File:Stalker's ring.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943601029120.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>stalkerring</nowiki>|<nowiki>stalkerring</nowiki>]]</span>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Bow attacks gain 3% (4% if </nowiki><strong><nowiki>shadow enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki>) crit chance
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shadow enchantment</nowiki></strong><nowiki> also adds 3% crit damage
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Occultist's ring</nowiki></u> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="occulistring">https://files.catbox.moe/horajv.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1245442140318863490.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ On cast, Necromancy attacks have a 10% chance to generate +2 stacks of Necrosis </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necrosis">[[File:Necrosis.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necrosis</nowiki>|<nowiki>necrosis</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • This does not affect conjure attacks or Bloat </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloat">[[File:Bloat.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloat</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> after the first hit
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Zorgoth's soul ring</nowiki></u> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zorgothsring">[[File:Zorgoth's soul ring.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1232124265826877574.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zorgothsring</nowiki>|<nowiki>zorgothsring</nowiki>]]</span>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Upgraded from Zorgoth's ring (quest reward from Requiem for a Dragon) while wearing it during rituals at the Ungael ritual site.
⬥ Necromancy hits have a 5% chance to generate +1 stack of Residual Soul </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="residualsoul">[[File:Residual Soul.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>residualsoul</nowiki>|<nowiki>residualsoul</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • This does not affect conjure attacks or Bloat </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloat">[[File:Bloat.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloat</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> after the first hit
    • AOE abilities like Blood Siphon </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloodsiphon">[[File:Blood Siphon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloodsiphon</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloodsiphon</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can proc for every target and every hit
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other Rings</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Reaver's Ring</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reaverring">[[File:Reaver's ring.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reaverring</nowiki>|<nowiki>reaverring</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> - +5% crit chance but -5% hitchance
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Asylum Surgeon's Ring</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="asr">[[File:Asylum surgeon's ring.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158472839208.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>asr</nowiki>|<nowiki>asr</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> - 30s cooldown if either occur:
    • 10% chance to prevent threshold cost
    • 40% chance to save 25% of spec cost
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ring of Vigour</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="rov">[[File:Ring of vigour.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>rov</nowiki>|<nowiki>rov</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> - Ultimates refund 10% adren, spec cost reduced by 10%; this can be made passive via the Extinction quest
</nowiki></div></div></div>

=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Notable Pocket Slots</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="jasgodbook">[[File:Scripture of Jas.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284342839513108.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>jasgodbook</nowiki>|<nowiki>jasgodbook</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is a very cheap pocket slot to buy and average to maintain, and relatively good to use (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="coins">[[File:Coins 10000.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>coins</nowiki>|<nowiki>coins</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> 61,798 per hour)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="scriptureofful">[[File:Scripture of Ful.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>scriptureofful</nowiki>|<nowiki>scriptureofful</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is an expensive pocket slot to buy, but is strong and very cheap to use (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="coins">[[File:Coins 10000.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>coins</nowiki>|<nowiki>coins</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> 70,346 per hour)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="grim">[[File:Erethdor's grimoire.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>grim</nowiki>|<nowiki>grim</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> a pivotal pocket slot for every style, but costly to use (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="coins">[[File:Coins 10000.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>coins</nowiki>|<nowiki>coins</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> 4,357,829 per hour), see </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>!grim</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for more info</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="scriptureofamascut">[[File:Scripture of Amascut.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>scriptureofamascut</nowiki>|<nowiki>scriptureofamascut</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="coins">[[File:Coins 10000.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>coins</nowiki>|<nowiki>coins</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> 257,735) / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="wengodbook">[[File:Scripture of Wen.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>wengodbook</nowiki>|<nowiki>wengodbook</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="coins">[[File:Coins 10000.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>coins</nowiki>|<nowiki>coins</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> 193,959) are both strong choices for killing mobs and AOE targets</nowiki></p>
